name: SAR448851
sort_evidence: SAR448851 is the oral TREM2 agonist VG-3927 acquired with Vigil Neuroscience, has no INN and no row in the book, and is in Phase 2 TREMHANCE NCT07688213 (Recruiting) (https://www.alzforum.org/therapeutics/sar448851).

trials.title: A Study to Investigate the Safety and Effectiveness of SAR448851 in Participants With Early Alzheimer's Disease
